title: ISA target table eps_decade index has no definition
description: ISA §8.1 expression grammar says {"table": name, "index": "k" | "eps_decade"}, but never defines eps_decade (floor/ceil/offset/domain), nor binds it in the variable table. VM cannot invent interoperable rounding or zero-epsilon index semantics. Reject with unimplemented: eps_decade index (milestone 4) until specified.

title: ISA 0.8 lacks published ref expansion library required by schedules
description: ISA §11: "bennett-isa-spec publishes the reference library ref (§17 item 7)." It must list every generated operation, ordinal, scratch identity and removable subset, with a version and hash. No such document exists in the published checkout. §17 descriptive defaults (ripple carry etc.) do not determine ordinal sequences or hash. VM cannot invent a shared contract; scheduled row lowering/accounting must reject E_SCHEDULE_INFEASIBLE until a library is published.

title: ISA should state complete-sector block_image encoding explicitly
description: ISA §7.3: "sector map from the block_image (else empty), 512-byte sectors; absent sectors read as zero". No explicit partial-final-sector or byte serialization rule is given. Reference rejects partial final images with §7.3 complete 512-byte sectors; VM now agrees after exposing stale-destination-byte behavior in inherited code. Make complete sectors explicit (or define padding) to avoid divergent loaders. No change to valid full-sector device semantics.

title: Published staged E scenarios disagree with target bytes
description: ISA §8.1: "A target is a JSON document in RFC 8785 canonical form; target_hash = SHA-256 of those bytes" and "an entry with epsilon 0 MUST NOT reference eps or log2inv_eps." E-epsilon-zero-entry target has cost time:1 and epsilon:0, with no eps reference, so MUST accept. E-jcs-target-hash file has trailing newline (not JCS), and expected hash includes it. Preserve strict canonical input and independent negative eps-reference witness; do not mutate read-only conformance.
